sections.excerpt: PROSPECTUS SUMMARY The following summary highlights information contained elsewhere in this prospectus. This summary is not complete and does not contain all of the information that you should consider before making a decision to invest in our Class A-1 common stock. sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt: Use of proceeds We estimate that the net proceeds to us from this offering will be approximately $719 million, or $827 million if the underwriters exercise their option to purchase additional shares of our Class A-1 common stock in full, based upon a public offering price of $28.50 per share, after deducting the underwriting discount and other estimated expenses. We intend to contribute the net proceeds from this offering to our operating company and receive 26,250,000 common units (or 30,187,500 common units if the underwriters exercise their option to purchase up to an additional 3,937,500 shares of our Class A-1 common stock in full), assuming the number of shares offered by us as set forth on the front cover of this prospectus remains the same.
